name: Orc to Bijo Dorei ~Otosareta Uruwashiki Senshi-tachi~
original_name: オークと美女奴隷～堕とされた麗しき戦士たち～
source:
Org the Orc returns home to find his village under siege by three stunning assassins. A princess knight, a she-elf, and a half-oni warrioress are slaughtering his people! Once the flames die down, he discovers all he holds dear is reduced to ashes... 

Wishing he were stronger, he mourns alone until a strange man approaches. “I don’t suppose you’d like to take revenge?” comes the slave trader’s fiendish offer. Org wants those beauties brought to their knees—even if it means siding with a human! Driven by desire and his newfound “lust” for vengeance, he embarks on a new quest...

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/revenge-of-the-orcs-en-zh/]Johren[/url]]
translation:
兽人奥格回到村庄，却发现这里正遭三名美艳刺客围攻：公主骑士、女精灵与半鬼族女战士正在屠杀村民！火焰熄灭后，他发现自己珍视的一切都化为灰烬……

他独自哀悼，渴望自己更强大时，一名奇怪男人走近。

“你想不想复仇？”

奴隶商人提出了恶毒的交易。奥格想让那些美人跪倒在自己面前，即使这意味着必须与人类合作！在欲望与新获得的“复仇之欲”驱使下，他踏上了新的任务……
